target_customer: Gen Z shoppers and the fashion and beauty creators who feature products
problem: Shopping lacked a social, creator-led experience; ShopWith let users browse virtual storefronts alongside creators and buy in app.
business_model: Marketplace / commerce platform (revenue model not sourced)

founders.name: Lewis Chung
founders.background_notes: Named only on a startup-history aggregator, not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mobile app with storefronts and checkout is standard engineering; content creation depends on creators.

defensibility.rationale: Copyable; two-sided creator/shopper network was not yet formed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Only an aggregator claims these platforms added native shopping that closed the gap; not independently confirmed.

market_need_then: TechCrunch Aug 2018 (via CB Insights snippet) picked ShopWith among Demo Day S18 day 2 startups, pitching creator storefronts; no usage or revenue data found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; tagline 'mobile QVC for GenZ' was its pitch.

outcome_analysis: ShopWith pitched mobile QVC for Gen Z at YC S18 Demo Day and then went Inactive; no company post-mortem exists. An aggregator estimates it stopped around April 2019 and blames app friction, native shopping on Instagram, YouTube and Pinterest, and cold-start problems, but this is the aggregator's own analysis. Factors are tentative. No follow-on funding was found.
notes: Failure factors are low-confidence, taken from an aggregator's analysis of unknown reliability (it cites Chung's LinkedIn-type profile for the shutdown date); the Hacker News comment it cites was not seen. CB Insights snippet gives founding 2016 and end 2020, conflicting with the aggregator (Oct 2017, ~Apr 2019). Funding: aggregator says YC only; $120K figure not confirmed as ShopWith's. Exit date left null. No dated competitor sources fetched; platforms named by the aggregator are not recorded as competitors. A later unrelated ShopWith (LoudCrowd) appears in search results. Completeness pass: the 120K seed of 2018-07-25 rests on a single database (CB Insights, another aggregator says 2018-08-04) and matches YC's standard deal; a dead startups archive says no follow-on round was raised.
